Callout.Name: Hunters on Private Land
Callout.Message: Two hunters with rifles on land they have no permission for.
Callout.Advisory: Both on foot, rifles slung, landowner confronting them.

Lines.Approach: They are on his land with rifles and he is out there arguing with them. Get there before he loses his temper.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
